chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Ali ibn Abdullah, who said:
I heard Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) saying: 'When Ibrahim, son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), passed away, three Sunnahs were enacted regarding him.'

As for the first: when he died, the sun was eclipsed, and the people said, 'The sun is eclipsed due to the loss of the Messenger of Allah's son.' So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ascended the pulpit, praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: 'O people! The sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah; they move by His command, obedient to Him. They do not eclipse for the death of anyone nor for his life. So if they eclipse, or one of them, pray.'

Then he descended from the pulpit and prayed Salat al-Kusuf (Prayer of the Eclipse) with the people. When he gave the greeting of peace, he said: 'O Ali! Arise and prepare my son.' So Ali (peace be upon him) arose, washed Ibrahim, embalmed him, and shrouded him. Then he went out with him, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) proceeded until he brought him to his grave.

The people said, 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forgot to pray Salat upon Ibrahim due to the grief that entered him.' So he stood upright and said: 'O people! Jibril (peace be upon him) came to me with what you said. You claimed that I forgot to pray Salat upon my son due to the grief that entered me. Indeed, it is not as you thought, it is not as you imagined, but the Subtle, the Aware has prescribed five Salats for you, and made for your deceased one Takbir from each Salat, and He commanded me that I should not pray Salat except upon one who prays Salat.'

Then he said: 'O Ali! Descend and dig the Lahd (side niche) for my son.' So he descended and dug the Lahd for Ibrahim in his grave. The people said, 'It is not befitting for anyone to descend into the grave of his son, as the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not do so.' So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to them: 'O people! It is not forbidden upon you to descend into the graves of your children, but I do not fear that if one of you loosens the shroud from his son, the Shaytan will play with him, causing grief to enter him that will nullify his reward.'
Then he turned away (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.لَحْدِهِ: His side niche (a type of grave)

ai.seo_question: What are the three Sunnahs enacted when Prophet Muhammad's son Ibrahim died?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes three key jurisprudential practices (Sunnahs) following the death of Ibrahim, the Prophet's son: the confirmation of Salat al-Kusuf as a distinct prayer not tied to human events, the obligation of Salat upon children, and the recommendation for the father to descend into the grave (al-had) to bury his child. The Prophet’s explanation highlights the psychological vulnerability of grief, noting that while it is not forbidden for others to enter, the father’s intense sorrow might lead to spiritual loss if distracted by Satan, thus emphasizing the need for composed ritual observance.
